reproducibility_gaps: Runtime dependency versions are not pinned in setup.py, including JAX, jaxlib and the scientific/solver stack.
The installation guide reports platform-dependent petsc4py installation difficulty and does not pin a mutually compatible PETSc, petsc4py, JAX and accelerator environment.
The repository states that FEM development moved to JAX-FEM and that the retained JAX-AM FEM code will not be updated further.
The pinned installation guide still uses the historical tianjuxue/jax-am clone URL while Stage 2 verifies the repository identity at the redirected CMSL-HKUST location.
No bundled numerical reference result or explicit acceptance threshold was identified for the bounded FEM demo.
notes: R2: source, license, package metadata, installation instructions and a concrete FEM entrypoint are present, but the unpinned runtime stack, platform-sensitive PETSc dependency, maintenance split and absence of a bounded reference result prevent a stronger static classification.
